name: 33785 · Indian Rk Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33785 (Indian Rk Bch) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33785 (Indian Rk Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33785 (Indian Rk Bch) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).
